title: 16 years of the sky: WISE, NEOWISE and SPHEREx
intro: Real coadds of the same field from three phases of two missions, placed on one time axis. Select a marker, or focus the view and use the arrow keys.
keys: Arrow keys step through epochs, Home and End jump to the first and last, Space plays and pauses.

controls.label: Playback
controls.reducedMotion: Playback is off because your system asks for reduced motion. Step with the buttons or the arrow keys.

frame.none: No frame is available for this epoch.

notice.different: The two missions have different pixels, bands and stretches. WISE frames share one stretch among themselves; SPHEREx frames share the stretch of their detector. Brightness is not comparable between the two missions.
notice.spherex: The SPHEREx frame shown is the per-detector coadd that overlaps the WISE {{band}} window ({{lo}} to {{hi}} µm) the most. It is not rebuilt from the exposures matched to that window, so its range can extend beyond the window.

codes.WISE_FRAME_LIST_PARQUET: The WISE frame list comes from the NEOWISE-R single-exposure table, which covers December 2013 to 2024 only. The 2010 to 2011 WISE epochs are missing, and no frame quality value is available.

astrometry.title: Proper motion over the full baseline
astrometry.unavailable: No long-baseline astrometry is stored for this sequence.
astrometry.failed: The stored astrometry could not be read.
astrometry.notMeasurable: The proper motion is not measurable from the stored epochs.
astrometry.pmra: Proper motion in right ascension (times cos declination)
astrometry.epochs: Epochs used: {{wise}} WISE and NEOWISE, {{spherex}} SPHEREx
astrometry.agreement: Agreement with the reference: {{sigma}} combined sigma (status: {{status}})
astrometry.spherexOnly: SPHEREx epochs alone give errors of {{ra}} and {{dec}} mas/yr, so the long baseline reduces them by a factor of {{rar}} and {{decr}}.
astrometry.referenceNote: The reference may use WISE and NEOWISE data itself, so the two values are not fully independent.
